lines: Tujhe bhoolna to chaha, lekin bhula na paaye
couplets.en: I wanted to forget you, but I never could.

lines: Jitna bhulana chaha, tum utna yaad aaye
couplets.en: The harder I tried to forget, the more you came to mind.

lines: Tujhe bhoolna to chaha, lekin bhula na paaye
couplets.en: I wanted to forget you, but I never could.

lines: Guzre zamane, sangdil, dekhi na teri surat
couplets.en: Ages have passed, cruel heart, since I last saw your face.

lines: Dil ko sata rahi hai, tere pyaar ki zaroorat
couplets.en: My heart still aches for your love.

lines: Aaye jab bhi yaad teri, meri neend rooth jaaye
couplets.en: Whenever you come to mind, sleep turns away from me.

lines: Tujhe bhoolna to chaha, lekin bhula na paaye
couplets.en: I wanted to forget you, but I never could.

lines: Tune qadr na jaana, anmol chahaton ka
couplets.en: You never saw what such devotion was worth.

lines: Khaya hai maine dhokha, tujhse mohabbaton ka
couplets.en: I loved you, and you deceived me.

lines: Allah kare yeh dhokha, tu bhi kisi se khaaye
couplets.en: May God let you taste that same betrayal at another's hands.

lines: Tujhe bhoolna to chaha, lekin bhula na paaye
couplets.en: I wanted to forget you, but I never could.

lines: Mere dil mein mere gham hain, armaan machal rahe hain
couplets.en: My heart holds its sorrows, and its longings stir.

lines: Khushiyon ke saare sapne, ashkon mein beh gaye
couplets.en: Every dream of joy was washed away in tears.

lines: Aane ka waada karke, tum aaj tak na aaye
couplets.en: You promised to come, and I am still waiting.

lines: Tujhe bhoolna to chaha, lekin bhula na paaye
couplets.en: I wanted to forget you, but I never could.

lines: Hai furqaton ka maara, hai maza hi kuchh nirala
couplets.en: There is a strange sweetness even in the ache of separation.

lines: Dekar lahoo jigar ka, yeh rog maine paala
couplets.en: I have kept this sickness alive with my own heart's blood.

lines: Sadiq, jahan mein aisa koi rog na lagaaye
couplets.en: Sadiq, may no one in this world take on such an illness.
